prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single original spaceship concept illustration for the game Stellar Echoes, human migration ark GUIHANG.
Primary request: redesign the ark using the disciplined naval/mechanical visual language of Mobile Suit Gundam spacecraft. The prior concepts were rejected as extravagant fantasy monuments. This image must immediately read as a convincing, handsome, powerful HUMAN SPACE CARRIER: unmistakable bow, continuous long main hull, small raised bridge, recessed hangar, heavy stern engine blocks. Original ship design, not a replica or a collage of any existing Gundam vessel.
Shape: one long, deep, substantial centerline hull, approximately five times as long as its width. A short faceted chisel-shaped prow, NOT a long needle. The large inhabited midship hull carries two stout armored shoulder volumes smoothly stepped into the main hull, not detached prongs. A compact two-tier command island rises above the aft third with short sensor masts; it must be very small relative to the ship. Thick side plating breaks into a handful of purposeful large sections with deep mechanical recesses between them. Visible near-side recessed rectangular shuttle hangar at midships, deep internal ribbing, doors, service gantry, one tiny shuttle entering. Strong connected stern structure contains four deep large engine nozzles with only soft blue idle illumination. Small attitude thrusters and short robust cooling vanes integrated close to the stern; no giant wings. The entire load path from armored bow to inhabited midbody to engines is visually coherent.
Civilization-ark identity: the ship has enormous enclosed deck depth, repeated sealed habitation sectors inside its thick midbody, a few tiny grouped warm window bands and one modest illuminated working port. Most sections are dark and sealed. Service bays, cargo hatches and small replacement armor patches convey long use. Interiors are protected; no exposed parks, forests, continuous luxury terraces, or decorative floating cores. A tiny 20-meter service craft beside the near-side hangar establishes the kilometer-class scale. Prioritize a memorable silhouette, not endless greebles or labels.
Art direction: professional high-end Japanese anime mecha spacecraft concept art with crisp intentional structural drawing and beautifully shaded hard-surface volumes. Hull planes in warm off-white and muted blue-gray; dark graphite mechanical depths; restrained brick-red identification blocks on the lower hull and shoulders, very small amber hazard marks. Naval industrial confidence, restrained asymmetric maintenance details on an otherwise balanced ship. Large clean planes dominate, medium block transitions support them, minute detail only at service interfaces. Subtle scuffs and repairs, not rusty wreckage. Emotion: formidable, dependable, a ship you want to command and return home to.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024, one complete ship only, elegant front-port three-quarter view with enough broadside and stern visible to read hangar and engines. Whole ship fits with generous margins, fills about 80 percent width. Neutral pale cool-gray presentation background and clear studio-style directional lighting; no planets, stars, explosions, lens flares, dramatic nebulae or cinematic background to disguise the design. One tiny service craft for scale, otherwise no other vessels. No text, logos, UI, borders, weapon batteries, mecha characters, halos, curved scythe blades, towers resembling buildings, giant rings, petals, seed shape, ornamental gold trim or marble. This is concept art, not a claim of engineering validation.
